description_en: Retrieve stream ingest records for a domain, an application under that domain, or a specific stream within a specified time range
description_zh: 获取某一时间段内某个域名（或域名下某应用或某个流）的推流记录
kebab_example: aliyun vs describe-vs-streams-publish-list --domain-name example.aliyundoc.com --app-name xxxApp --stream-name xxxStream --start-time 2016-06-29T19:00:00Z --end-time 2016-06-30T19:00:00Z --page-size 3000 --page-number 1 --stream-type all --query-type fuzzy --order-by publish_time_asc --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVsStreamsPublishList

parameters.help_en: The application name of the live stream
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en:
The start time.

Use UTC format. Example: 2016-06-29T19:00:00Z
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time.

Use UTC format. Example: 2016-06-30T19:00:00Z

The interval between EndTime and StartTime must not exceed 30 days
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间。
UTC格式。例如：2016-06-30T19:00:00Z
EndTime和StartTime之间的间隔不能超过30天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Default value: 3000.
Valid values: 1 to 3000.
parameters.help_zh:
每页大小。默认值：3000。  
取值范围：[1,3000]
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The stream type. Valid values:

all (all streams) (default)

raw (raw stream)

trans (transcoded stream)
parameters.help_zh:
流类型。取值范围：
all（所有流）（默认）
raw（原始流）
trans（转码流）
parameters.name: stream_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use fuzzy matching for the stream name. Valid values:

fuzzy (fuzzy match)

strict (exact match)
parameters.help_zh:
指定是否模糊匹配流名称。取值范围：
fuzzy（模糊匹配）
strict（精准匹配）
parameters.name: query_type

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

stream_name_desc (sort by stream name in descending order)

stream_name_asc (sort by stream name in ascending order)

publish_time_desc (sort by publish time in descending order)

publish_time_asc (sort by publish time in ascending order) (default)
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式。取值范围：
stream_name_desc（按直播流名称倒序）
stream_name_asc（按直播流名称升序）
publish_time_desc（按推流时间倒序）
publish_time_asc（按推流时间升序）（默认值）
parameters.name: order_by
